bootstrap.undefined: omit undefined ratios and count them

readings.bootstrapPopulation: games retained for each rule, separately for train and heldout
readings.tree: greedy categorical Gini; maximum depth 2; deterministic feature/cell order; ties predict sound
readings.emptyCells: undefined differences cannot establish a failure; no extra minimum count
readings.failureGap: cell minus all remaining cells of that split; at most -0.10 in each period

operations.timingDefinition: Worker seconds sum elapsed worker time across workers and resumes; stage seconds sum completed/stopped invocation wall times. Completed-row instrument time excludes failed attempts, which are reported separately. Unknown stopped durations remain unknown; known elapsed portions are reported separately.
operations.missing: null means the instrument did not report this count or time

amendmentAvailability.comparison: Amended availability versus the original gain-only definition; Lucena and Philidor also versus raw mover-note availability before the side filter.
